blank: Is a lamp brought to be put under a ___
usage: 現代英語仍用 hide your light under a bushel（同源自這類經文）比喻埋沒自己的才能不使人知道

text: with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you
blank: with whatever ___ you measure, it will be measured to you
gloss: 你怎樣對待別人，也將怎樣被對待
usage: 現代英語有時引用 the measure you give will be the measure you get 或類似說法，表達因果對等的原則

blank: because they were like sheep without a ___
usage: 現代英語常用 like sheep without a shepherd 形容群體缺乏領導、茫然無措

text: honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me
blank: this people honors me with their ___, but their heart is far from me
gloss: 口惠而實不至，虛偽的敬意
usage: 現代英語常用 pay lip service 表達口頭尊重卻無實際誠意，概念源自此類聖經典故

blank: rulers over the nations ___ it over them
gloss: 作威作福、對人頤指氣使
usage: 現代英語常用 lord it over someone 形容以權勢對人頤指氣使、擺架子

text: gave all that she had to live on
blank: she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to ___ on
gloss: 傾其所有的奉獻（喻微小卻珍貴的付出）
usage: 現代英語常引用 the widow's mite 比喻雖然微小卻代表全部付出的貴重奉獻
